note: Synthetic data. Describes what was planted and what the default configuration is expected to report.

scenarios.name: benign_fumble
scenarios.description: 3 failed logins then a success within ~100 s, from the user's usual address.

scenarios.name: repeated_failures_no_success
scenarios.description: 12 failed logins for 'admin' in about 4 minutes, never followed by a success.

scenarios.name: success_after_repeated_failures
scenarios.description: 6 failed logins in ~4 minutes, then a success ~60 s after the last failure, same address.

scenarios.name: password_spray_pattern
scenarios.description: 1 failed login each for 8 accounts in ~6 minutes from one address; one later success for 'frank'.

scenarios.name: shared_nat_false_positive
scenarios.description: 5 colleagues behind one office address each fail once during an SSO hiccup, then succeed. Benign by construction.

scenarios.name: slow_low_rate_attempts
scenarios.description: 12 failed logins spread over ~3 hours (one per 15 min). Missed by design with default settings.

scenarios.name: distributed_single_account
scenarios.description: 6 failures for one account, each from a different address, then a success from a 7th. Missed by design.
